name: g66_blade_shield_cycle
purpose: Stance Change (decision 0040, step G66): Aegislash (M) Iron Head changes it to Aegislash-Blade before the move line (-formechange, [from] ability: Stance Change). Turn 2, King's Shield (priority 4, first) changes it back to the Shield before the move line; Garchomp's contact Dragon Claw is stopped (-activate move: Protect) and Garchomp's Attack drops (-unboost). Garchomp is faster, so its turn-1 hit lands on the Shield form.
